correct_completion: we arrived at the meeting after it started.
full_sentence: Because the bus was late, we arrived at the meeting after it started.
acceptable_variants: we missed the first part of the meeting.
we entered the room after it had begun.

options.text: although we had planned to leave early.
options.why_wrong: 'Although' signals contrast, but the stem needs a cause-effect link with 'because', so this clause does not show a result.
This is unrelated to the bus being late, so it does not complete the cause-effect relation.

options.text: we arrived at the meeting after it started.

options.why_wrong: This describes a future event, which does not follow logically from the bus being late.

explanation: After 'because', the first clause gives the cause and the main clause gives the result. The completion must describe what happened as a result of the late bus.
translation: Porque o ônibus estava atrasado, chegamos à reunião depois que ela começou.
